fields.description: The name of this use case. Crema keeps this list up to date for you.
fields.label: Use Case

fields.description: The short name used when calling Crema from code. Crema fills this in for you.
fields.label: Use Case Key

fields.description: Which AI service answers for this use case. Leave empty to use the Default Provider set above.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: Which model to use. Leave empty to use the Default Model set above. You can only pick one once this row has its own Provider, because the list comes from that provider.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: What this use case has cost so far this month, against its spending limit. Shown live — never saved.
fields.label: Usage

fields.description: The account Crema acts as for this use case. It can only read and write what that account is allowed to. Give it as little access as the job needs. It cannot be Administrator or a System Manager. Leave empty to use the Default Runs-As User set above.
fields.label: Runs As

fields.description: The most this use case may spend per calendar month. 0 means no limit of its own — the Default Monthly Limit applies instead. A request that would go over is stopped before the AI service is called.
fields.label: Monthly Budget (USD)
Creativity
fields.description: 0 gives the steadiest, most repeatable answers. Higher values let the model vary its wording. Leave at 0 unless you want variety.
The most the model may write back. 0 lets the AI service use its own limit.
fields.label: Longest Answer

fields.description: Remember an answer and reuse it for the same request during this time, at no extra cost. 0 asks the AI fresh every time.
fields.label: Reuse Answers For (seconds)

fields.description: Check the text for known attack patterns before sending it. Runs on this server, costs nothing, and blocks anything suspicious. Keep this on.
fields.label: Text Scan

fields.description: Have a second AI read the text first and judge whether it is safe. Slower and costs extra. Needs the Security use case to have a working provider.
fields.label: AI Guard

fields.description: Ask the model to repeat a secret word back, to prove the reply is really its own and was not hijacked. Off — do not check. Log Only — note it and use the reply anyway. Retry Once — try once more, then stop. Block — stop the request.
fields.label: Reply Check
fields.options:
Off
Log Only
Retry Once
Block

fields.description: Background instructions sent with every request for this use case. Leave empty to use Crema's built-in wording.
fields.label: Standing Instructions
